hooks: MAKE Beauty Cream Supreme lipstick is $13, half off, all 12 shades.
MERIT's only sale of the year: the Erdem lip trio is $62.

brands.verdict: Up to 50% off sitewide; these three are the half-off ones, $13 to $15 each.
brands.say: Cream Supreme lipstick, $13 from $26. Refillable, glossy finish, 12 shades.

items.why: Refillable cream lipstick with a glossy finish and vitamin E, all 12 shades in stock.
items.for_who: Wants to try a few shades cheaply

items.why: Gel blush tint with a dewy, watercolor effect, $15, all eight shades in stock.
items.skip_if: You want powder or full-coverage color

items.why: Mascara for volume, length and definition with a vegan beeswax alternative, $13 from $26.

brands.verdict: Their only sale all year: 20% off any order, 25% off orders over $150.
brands.say: Erdem lip trio, $62 for three lipsticks that cost $28 each alone.

items.why: Limited edition ERDEM set of three Signature lipsticks in three finishes, one shade exclusive.
items.for_who: Wants three lipsticks at about $21 each

items.why: Lightweight lipstick; marked $22.40 in five in-stock shades, the rest still list at $28.
items.skip_if: Your shade is Tiger, Classic, Maison, Equestrian or Slip

items.why: Sheer, buildable lip pencil; only Tabac and Capricorn are marked $16.80, other shades show $24.
items.for_who: Wants soft definition, no hard lines
items.skip_if: You need a different shade at 30% off

brands.verdict: Archive items are 40% off and tagged final sale; the rest of the site is 25%.
brands.say: Radiance Elixir serum, $135 from $225. Skincare, and still the priciest thing here.

items.why: Illuminating peptide serum, a skincare step, made in Switzerland, $135 from $225.
items.for_who: Already uses it and needs a refill

items.why: Illuminating powder blush with shimmer from the Éclat Cristalline collection, $63 from $105.
items.skip_if: You want matte blush; final sale

items.why: Lip color in shade Guava at $33 from $55; the product page gave me no details.
items.skip_if: You can't swatch it first; final sale

brands.verdict: Sets are 25 to 32% off through November 30, with gifts on orders over $100.
brands.say: Starter Ritual set, $95 from $140. Travel sizes, tagged for dry, mature skin.

items.why: Set of travel-size minis tagged for dry and mature skin, with Japanese silk extract.
items.for_who: Trying Tatcha before buying full sizes
items.skip_if: You want full sizes, or makeup

items.why: Moisture duo gift set, $126 from $168; gift wrap adds $5.
items.skip_if: You wanted makeup; this is skincare

items.why: Glow and Protect gift set at $123 from $164, 25% off, in stock.
items.for_who: Wants a boxed set to give
items.skip_if: You need the contents list; I had none

close: Tell me a beauty brand and I'll check its sale next.
